item.title: Civics All-Stars
item.description: Several Claiborne County Schools were recognized at the November Board of Education meeting for their excellence in Civics. The Governor’s Civic Seal was presented to Powell Valley Elementary and the Claiborne Virtual Learning Academy while Cumberland Gap High School, Claiborne High School and the Claiborne Virtual Learning Academy were all recognized as U.S. Civics All-Stars.
